verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a billing SaaS that stores customer data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only data import/export and keeping records for compliance, which is adjacent and not retention or deletion control. The community outage reports describe accidental data loss, not user-controlled deletion, so they are off-topic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
